nodes.title: LLM Node - Brief Expansion (GLM-5.3-Flash)
widgets_values: You are a prompt-expansion engine for a locked-brand image pipeline. Reply with ONLY one strict JSON object. No markdown fences, no commentary, no keys other than the six slot ids. The object must have exactly these keys: anchor_hardware, anchor_interface, asset_app_icon, asset_dashboard_shell, asset_packaging, asset_social_banner. Each key maps to an object with exactly one field named prompt: one dense paragraph of 40 to 110 words that restates the locked palette hex codes (alabaster #F5F3EE, stone #E8E3D9, aluminum #D8D4CC, ink #18181B, terra #C84B31), the materials, the soft directional morning daylight from camera-left, and the negative constraints (no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no neon glow, no purple or cyan lighting, no glossy CGI plastic, no floating particles). The only brand is DATUM-01. Do not invent other products or brands.

Expand the DATUM-01 brief into exactly six asset prompts. Brand: DATUM-01, a fictional minimalist desktop climate and air-quality monitor with a companion dashboard app. Tagline: Calm environmental telemetry for quiet workspaces. Raw baseline brief: Create a clean product visual for DATUM-01, a minimalist desktop climate monitor and companion app. Locked palette: alabaster #F5F3EE primary background ground; stone #E8E3D9 secondary neutral surface; aluminum #D8D4CC brushed metal neutral; ink #18181B matte charcoal graphite; terra #C84B31 single signature anodized terracotta accent. Materials: matte warm-alabaster ceramic; bead-blasted brushed aluminum; pale honed limestone; matte charcoal graphite; anodized terracotta accent dot. Lighting: Soft directional morning daylight from camera-left, matte surfaces, subtle architectural shadows, no neon glow, no text or watermarks. Negative constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no neon glow, no purple or cyan lighting, no glossy CGI plastic, no floating particles. Slots: anchor_hardware (anchor, 16:9, Hardware Material Sheet); anchor_interface (anchor, 16:9, UI Surface and Grid Sheet); asset_app_icon (remix, 1:1, App Icon); asset_dashboard_shell (remix, 16:9, Companion Dashboard); asset_packaging (remix, 3:2, Retail Packaging); asset_social_banner (remix, 16:9, Launch Header). Return the six-slot JSON object now.

groups.title: 3 - Phase B: approved references and batch

studio_notes.fixture: DATUM-01 is a fictional product fixture. This graph is self-contained and uses only the DATUM-01 fixture.
studio_notes.purpose: Brand-locked asset factory: two anchor sheets first, then one batched style-locked remix fan-out.
run_order: Phase A (nodes 2, 3, 4, 5): run the two Reve Create anchors, review them in My Media, and keep the approved sheets as approved/anchor_hardware.png and approved/anchor_interface.png.

Phase B (nodes 6 to 16): point both GMI Image Upload nodes at the approved files, then run. GMI Batch Images (node 8) fans the two anchors out to four parallel Reve Remix nodes (9 to 12), each saved by its own Save Image node (13 to 16).
studio_notes.llm_node_role: Node 1 (LLM Node, zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 2048) expands the brief into six strict-JSON slot prompts. Its content output is a review artifact and is not wired to a generation node, because the docs describe no JSON-slice node. Copy each slot prompt into the matching widget, or use outputs/expanded_prompts.json from run_factory.py --expand.
studio_notes.baseline_slots: baseline_dashboard and baseline_packaging are generated outside this graph from the raw brief only (no LLM expansion, no anchor batch) so the factory can be compared against them.
studio_notes.one_click_publish: In the Inspector Parameters tab, use each input's menu to Favorite it, so it appears under Workflow Overview > Parameters. One-Click Execution in the Workflow Gallery hides the topology and exposes only favorited inputs. Publish from the canvas toolbar only after the two anchor files exist, because the upload nodes need approved files that come from Phase A and a manual approval step.
studio_notes.run_cost_note: Runs spend credits per model node: two Reve Create, four Reve Remix, and the LLM node.
unverified_against_docs: The GMI Studio docs list Reve Create and Reve Remix outputs as VIDEO, video_url, and file_path. This graph assumes an IMAGE output wired into Save Image. Confirm in the Studio editor before any paid run.
The batch input names image_1 and image_2 and the Reve Remix image input name are taken from the tutorial and node reference. Confirm them in the editor.
The docs publish no export schema for Studio workflows. The file uses ComfyUI UI-format fields (nodes, links, groups, config, extra). Re-save from Studio before importing.
